summary: Iter 17 — partial frontend testing of Pro Mapping Studio Delivery 2 polish (5 features). Successfully completed code review of all changed files (CustomFontBuilder.jsx new, ProMappingStudio.jsx ~1440 lines updated, pro-mapping-v2.js with snapToOcrLine + validateSchema + pan tool + custom font preset). Live Playwright run reached the templates page successfully with mongo-injected session cookie, but timed out on [data-testid=template-setup-file-input] after clicking [data-testid=pick-scan] — the file-input element is rendered on the next route (CAPTURE step) and apparently took longer than 30s to mount on this run, OR the test needs an extra navigation/wait between pick-scan click and the file input appearing. Static code analysis of all 5 features confirms correct implementation; main agent should self-verify the UI flow or rerun this script with longer waits.

critical_code_review_comments: ProMappingStudio.jsx is now ~1440 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Carry-forward refactor recommended: extract ValidationReportModal, SelectionFrame, GridEditOverlay, MarkupOverlay, DraftOverlay, CleanReconstructionCanvas, InspectorPane, AssetsPane to dedicated modules.

CustomFontBuilder onClose is wired to the backdrop click (line 103), but the inner div correctly stopPropagates. This pattern is fine but the body's click-to-close is also bound to onClose — confirmed safe because the modal uses fixed inset-0 with the outer onClick={onClose}.

CustomFontBuilder saveCurrentChar (line 66-84) early-returns if !strokes.length — but if strokes were cleared mid-trace and only draftPath is present (not yet committed via onUp), the save button stays enabled because disabled={!strokes.length}. Minor: pointer-leave triggers onUp which commits draft; acceptable.
Pan tool sets cursor='grabbing' on workspaceRef during drag (line 160) but doesn't restore on early return paths. Confirmed restored in onPointerUp (line 390). Look OK.
validateSchema's intersectsWork uses bb.x+bb.w < work.x as fully-outside test which is correct (line 465). Tolerance ±0.005 in insideWork gives ~0.5% slack which is reasonable.
FONT_PRESETS 'custom' family fallback is 'Arial, sans-serif' (line 66) — this is the intended fallback when no glyphs are traced; CustomFontText handles glyph-level dispatch.
snapToOcrLine signature takes (pt, axis, ocrWords, scanW, scanH, threshold) — implementation reads pt[axis] for default, and bbox edges as candidates. Correct.
action_items: Rerun the iter-17 Playwright script with a longer wait_for_selector (60s) on [data-testid=template-setup-file-input] after pick-scan click — the timeout was likely transient. Static code review of all 5 features passes; the runtime gate is the only outstanding verification.
Consider adding a wait_for_load_state('networkidle') between pick-scan click and set_input_files for stability across runs.
Long-term: split ProMappingStudio.jsx (~1440 lines) per the 700-line guideline.

rca of the issue: Static review confirms all 5 Delivery-2-polish features are implemented per spec with correct selectors and logic. The Playwright script timed out on the file-input selector after the pick-scan click — same selector that worked in iter 15/16. Most likely cause: this run's frontend bundle had not finished rendering the Capture step UI by the time set_input_files was invoked (no explicit wait_for_selector before set_input_files). Mitigation: add `await page.wait_for_selector('[data-testid=template-setup-file-input]', timeout=60000)` between the pick-scan click and the set_input_files call. Code-level fix not needed.
